focused.description: Whether the new Agent Window should take focus. Omitted means the extension's default (`false`).

height.description: Optional Agent Window outer height in CSS pixels (100..=7680).

incognito.description: Use Chrome's shared incognito browsing session. Omitted means normal.

width.description: Optional Agent Window outer width in CSS pixels (100..=7680).

window_id.description: Append a background tab to this normal window; -1 selects the current user window (reject ambiguous candidates). Other IDs must be positive. Never fall back.
